verdict.rationale: Modal documents Sandboxes as "secure containers for executing untrusted user or agent code" and its docs include a "VM Sandboxes Beta" section, which points to a VM-based isolation option. But the pack only has that heading, so nothing describes the boundary's technology, guarantees or threat model, and the default is containers. missing for 10: documented isolation technology (microVM/gVisor or equivalent) and its guarantees, GA status rather than beta for VM sandboxes, a threat-model or security-boundary description, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can rely on a documented hard isolation boundary (microVM or equivalent) between sandboxes and my systems
